senses.sense_definition: A decrease in the level of oxygen carried by hemoglobin in the blood.

examples.text: The nurse monitored the patient closely to prevent severe oxygen <w>desaturation</w> during the procedure.
Patients suffering from sleep apnea often experience episodes of nocturnal <w>desaturation</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The chemical conversion of a saturated compound into an unsaturated one by removing atoms to form double or triple bonds.

examples.text: Enzymatic fatty acid <w>desaturation</w> is a vital step in synthesizing lipids required for cell membranes.
The research team studied the biochemical <w>desaturation</w> of hydrocarbons using specialized catalysts.
